Build from source

POTACAT is open source. If you'd rather build it yourself, clone the repo and run one of the dist:* scripts.

Requires Git and Node.js 22+.

Linux only: install build deps first: sudo apt install build-essential python3 libudev-dev cmake libhamlib-utils

$ git clone https://github.com/Waffleslop/POTACAT.git
$ cd POTACAT
$ npm install
$ npm run dist:win     # or dist:mac / dist:linux

Installer appears in the dist/ folder.
